🎬 KAMED STUDIO już za chwilę  gramy w Łodzi !
26,27,28,29,30 października bądźcie z nami !

Dojazd na plan we własnym zakresie .

Poszukujemy kobiet i mężczyzn w wieku 17–45 lat do udziału w zdjęciach filmowych w Łodzi do bajecznej komedii romantycznej !

🍒 WESELE – 26 i 27 października

* Zdjęcia dzienne
* Wymagana dyspozycyjność w oba dni (kontynuacja ).
* Wynagrodzenie: 300 zł netto za dwa dni zdjęciowe
* Płatność po zakończeniu drugiego dnia zdjęciowego gotówka 

🍒 BAL – 28, 29 i 30 października

* Zdjęcia dzienno-nocne
* Wymagana dyspozycyjność we wszystkie trzy dni ( kontynuacja)
* Wynagrodzenie: 520 zł netto za cały blok zdjęciowy
* Płatność po zakończeniu trzeciego dnia zdjęciowego .

Uwaga ! 

Drodzy stroje adekwatne do okazji ślubu wesela i balu .

Elegancja szyk wdzięk ❤️.

Nie znamy na tą chwilę dokładnych godzin prosimy aby zgłaszały się osoby dyspozycyjne .

Zgłoszenia prosimy przesyłać na adres:
📧 impresariat.kamedstudio@gmail.com

W wiadomości prosimy podać:

🙂Imię i nazwisko oraz wiek

☎️ Numer telefonu kontaktowego

📸Aktualne zdjęcie twarzy i sylwetki
w stylizacji w której planujecie przyjść

 ❤️W tytule maila dopisek : Łódź+ data na które się zgłaszasz

Można zgłosić się na dwa bloki zdjęć .

items.text:
**WARSZAWA**

**25 / 26 /27 / 28 października**

**Serial fabularny KB**

**Stawki 130-170 zł gotówką po planie**

** **

Akcja serialu KB toczy się dalej. Komenda policji musiała się pojawić wcześniej czy później.

 

**25 / 26 / 27 PAŹDZIERNIKA:**

**- POLICJANCI MUNDUROWI I CYWILNI / INTERESANCI **– wiek ok. 18-55 lat. Można zgłaszać się na 1 dzień lub wszystkie. Kontynuacja nie jest wymagana. **Stawka 130 zł gotówką.**

**- PRZECHODNIE **– tylko 25.10. **Stawka 130 zł gotówką.**

**- ULTRASI** – tylko 25.10. Mężczyźni 18-45 lat. **Stawka 130 zł gotówką.**

 

**25 / 26 /27 / 28 PAŹDZIERNIKA**

**- POLICJANCI KONTYNUACYJNI –** na 4 dni. Mężczyźni ok. 20-40 lat. Rozmiar M lub L. Stawka 170 zł za dzień zdjęciowy. **Płatne ostatniego dnia kontynuacji 680 zł gotówką.**

 

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **KB + dzień, który Was interesuje **lub **KB KONT**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

W załączniku: **aktualne** **zdjęcie twarzy (selfie najlepiej) i koniecznie aktualne zdjęcie sylwetki (oczywiście w ubraniu).**

 

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka

Poszukujemy Hosta (mężczyzny), który wcieli się w rolę atrakcyjnego, „niegrzecznego” Świętego Mikołaja na Targi w Krakowie w dniu 24.10.2026 (sobota) w godzinach 11:00–19:00.

1. Zależy nam na osobie, która dobrze czuje się w kontakcie z ludźmi i swobodnie odnajduje się przed obiektywem. Jeśli chodzi o sam wygląd, zależy nam na wyrazistym, atrakcyjnym wizerunku eventowym – mile widziana jest również dobra, zadbana sylwetka, ponieważ postać ma być celowo przedstawiona jako bardziej „sexy” wersja Świętego Mikołaja. Oczywiście ważne jest dla nas również to, żeby wybrana osoba była komunikatywna, otwarta i dobrze czuła się w tego typu aktywacjach.

2. Wynagrodzenie: 650 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 3 dni po targach na konto bankowe lub BLIK na numer telefonu).

W razie zainteresowania, dostępności w podanym terminie i spełnieniu wymagań prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy

5. Adres e-mail

6. Wzrost

7. Link do swojego profilu na Facebooku

8. Opis dotychczasowego doświadczenia

9. Minimum 3 zdjęcia

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Targi Kraków

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w targach zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

OPPORTUNITY FOR ACTORS (UNPAID, NON EQUITY). PLEASE NOTE THIS PROJECT IS FULLY VIRTUAL. YOU CAN PARTICIPATE FROM ANYWHERE YOU PLEASE!

Rainy Day Artistic Collective (RDAC), is seeking actors for this year’s iteration of our annual year-end show, “Twisted Tales,” a fully virtual one act festival of short plays that highlight new “takes” and “twists” on familiar stories. 

Whether you’re an on-camera veteran or doing it for the first time, we encourage you to audition! This year’s festival features five exciting 10(ish) minute plays, all of which currently have 1-3 open roles that we’re actively casting for.

Unfortunately at this time we are not able to provide stipends for actors; we completely understand if this is a deal breaker. As we grow, increasing funding for stipends is our #1 financial priority. 

This event will be free for all to tune in and enjoy.

Performances will be livestreamed December 4th and 5th. For the rehearsal schedule, please refer to the included form (linked below), but for the majority of pieces our first rehearsal will be on November 12th. All rehearsals are also fully virtual.

If you would like to audition, please fill out this form: https://forms.gle/LxJerXd7SyD5ARfX7

A resume and headshot, though not 100% required to audition, will 
be extremely helpful tools for us especially if we’ve not worked with you in the past.

What we definitely need: a self tape of a 1-2 minute monologue. Contemporary is best, but whatever you have ready will work - we mostly want to see a sample of you performing! (If you happen to have an acting reel, that will also work great.)

A casting breakdown of all available roles is also included in the form.

If you wish to audition but experience any obstacles, please reach out and let us know and we are happy to do our best to help accommodate. RDAC is committed to doing all we reasonably can to remove any barriers to audition accessibility.

RDAC is committed to diverse and inclusive casting and welcomes actors from any and all backgrounds and experience levels to audition for all of our projects.

Our current deadline for auditions is November 3rd, 2026 at 11:59pm PST. We expect to make casting decisions and communicate any role offers within a couple days of this deadline.

Thank you, and please email rainydayrevue@gmail.com if you have any questions - we may not see any comments as quickly.

Casting Call
🎬 NOW CASTING – 4 THE GIRLS! 🎬

🎥 An Independent Feature Film

Written by Dashaye Clarke

🚨 CASTING CALL – ACTORS WANTED! 🚨

We are currently seeking talented, dedicated, and passionate actors to join the cast of our upcoming feature film, 4 THE GIRLS!

🎭 AVAILABLE ROLES:

💕 TORI – Supporting Role

A character who brings personality, drama, and memorable moments to the storyline. Seeking an actress who can deliver natural dialogue, strong emotions, and authentic performances.

💕 Jade – Supporting Role

A character involved in a complicated romantic storyline filled with love, jealousy, and unexpected twists. Seeking an actress who can portray emotional depth, confidence, vulnerability, and relationship tension.

🎭 DEVIN – UNDERSTUDY NEEDED

Seeking a dependable male actor to serve as an understudy for Devin, Shanae’s husband. This character navigates marriage struggles, temptation, dishonesty, and emotional conflict.

The understudy must be willing to learn the role, attend rehearsals when needed, and be prepared to step in for filming if necessary.

🎬 PRODUCTION DETAILS:

📍 Raleigh North Carolina

🎥 Independent Feature Film

📅 Filming dates will be provided to selected actors.

🎬 UNPAID but IMDB Credits will be provided. 

✨ WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

* Strong acting ability and natural delivery

* Professionalism and reliability

* Ability to take direction

* Commitment to rehearsals and filming

* Great energy and a positive attitude

📩 INTERESTED IN AUDITIONING?

Please send:

* Your name

* The role you’re interested in

* A recent headshot or clear photo

* Acting experience (if applicable)

* A demo reel or self-tape (if available)

To dashayeclarke@gmail.com 

Or DM Me! 

🎬 4 THE GIRLS is a story of friendship, love, betrayal, secrets, and the unbreakable bond between four women navigating life’s unexpected challenges.

🔥 Come be part of something unforgettable!

#4TheGirls #NowCasting #CastingCall #NCActors #IndependentFilm #ActorsWanted #FeatureFilm #Understudy #WomenInFilm

**CASTING CALL: *****SEVEN DEUCE***

**Format:** Short Film / 1970s Neo-Noir Crime Thriller

**Location:** Watkins,CO

**Shoot Dates:** November 14th and 15th

**Pay:** Paid / Non-Union Meals, Footage, and Credit provided

**Logline:** In 1975, a fortified, high-stakes underground poker game spirals out of control when greed, blackmail, undercover surveillance, and paranoia explode into a bloody 3:00 AM standoff.

**OPEN ROLES**
* **SEAT 1: THE NAMELESS VET (Male, 30s)**
* Lean, hardened, haunted. A Vietnam veteran with a dead-eyed thousand-yard stare and lethal military stillness. Speaks in a flat, quiet rasp. Economy of movement; thinks like an ambush survivor.
* **SEAT 2: JIMMY "SPRINTS" (Male, Late 20s–Early 30s)**
* Gaunt, manic, hyperactive, constantly drenched in sweat. A compulsive degenerate gambler in way over his head with loan sharks. Swings wildly between manic euphoria and breathless terror. Big physical and emotional range.
* **SEAT 3: AGENT KANE / "MILLER" (Male, 30s)**
* Sharp, handsome, tailored, cool under pressure. An undercover federal agent wearing a wire, desperately trying to keep his cover intact while counting down the minutes to a tactical raid. Needs an exceptional, subtle poker face.
* **SEAT 4: LEONARD SMOOTHS (Black Male, Late 30s–Early 40s)**
* Tall, imposing, velvet street elegance. A charismatic, stylish pimp with an icy, calculating demeanor. Commands the room with a smooth baritone, but possesses explosive, bare-knuckle violence when pushed.
* **SEAT 5: FRANK "NUMBERS" (Male, 50s–60s)**
* Broad, gravel-voiced mob veteran with horn-rimmed glasses and cold calculation. Treats the high-stakes game like an accounting spreadsheet. The calmest, smartest criminal in the cellar.
* **SEAT 6: RAY "SOLLY" SULLIVAN (Male, 40s–50s)**
* Heavyset, greasy, sweat-soaked, brutal. A deeply corrupt detective who uses his badge as a weapon of extortion and street bullying. Vicious, loud, remorseless, and arrogant.
* **THE DEALER (Female or Male, Late 30s–40s)**
* Sharp, immaculate, surgical. Total mechanical precision with cards and zero visible emotion. Commands absolute authority over dangerous, armed men through icy house rules.
* **WALTER / THE HEAVY (Male, 40s–50s)**
* Imposing, broad, weathered 230+ lb enforcer guarding the cellar door with a shotgun. A man of few words with terrifying physical presence.
**HOW TO SUBMIT**

Please email your **Headshot, Resume, and Reel (or self-tape link)** to:

📧 **tyler.j.stewart14@gmail.com**

**Subject Line:** *7DEUCE - [Role Name] - [Your Full Name]*

*Sides and self-tape instructions will be sent upon review. Feel free to share or tag talent who fit these period roles!*

**SEEKING ACTORS FOR STUDENT PRODUCED TELEVISION SHOW**

**Title:** The Bluffs: Season 13

**Genre:** Dramedy

**Logline: **A punk rocker down on his luck and his funds starts rigging bets using UCCS’s new betting app to pay his mounting pile of bills.

**Roles: **

**HAYDEN: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - MALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

A STRUGGLING PUNK ROCK MUSICIAN. REBELLIOUS AND IMPULSIVE, HE IS TORN BETWEEN BEING FINANCIALLY STABLE AND LIVING AN AUTHENTIC PUNK LIFESTYLE ***THIS ROLE REQUIRES SINGING**

**GRACE: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - FEMALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN’S BEST FRIEND, ROOMMATE, AND BANDMATE. SHE IS QUIETLY CONFIDENT AND HAS A STRONG SENSE OF HER OWN MORALS. VERY PUNK.

**DARBY: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - FEMALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN’S COWORKER WHO IS IN A COMPETING PUNK BAND, ALTHOUGH YOU PROBABLY WOULDN’T KNOW THAT BY LOOKING AT HER. VERY BUSINESS MINDED, SHE IS MORE INTERESTED IN BEING A MUSICIAN FOR THE MONEY AND CLOUT THAN FOR THE ARTISTIC EXPRESSION.

**JP: (30-50 YEARS OLD) - MALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN AND DARBY’S BOSS AND THE BRAIN BEHIND UCCS’ NEW BLUFFBETS APP. A MIDDLE-AGED TECH BRO WHO DESPERATELY TRIES TO BE HIP AND APPEAL TO HIS STUDENT EMPLOYEES.

**Production Company:** UCCS Digital Filmmaking Program

**Production Type: **Student Television Show

**Contact Information:** vsmith@uccs.edu

**Run Time: **Television Show, three 10ish minute episdodes

**Compensation: **Unpaid

**Union Status:** Non-Union

**Audition Information:** October 24th from 2 pm to 7 pm at UCCS, by appointment only: 

https://calendly.com/vsmith-uccs/bluffsseason13audition

Shooting Schedule:

October 31st, 9AM-7PM

November 7th, 9AM-7PM

November 14th, 9AM-7PM

November 21st, 9AM-7PM

December 5th, 9AM-7PM

December 12th, 9AM-7PM

December 19th, 9AM-7PM

***Shoot dates called will depend on the role. Please look at each character to see how frequently we expect you to be called based on the character you audition for**

**Filming Location:** Various, mostly on the UCCS campus, every location with be in Colorado Springs.

**Project Description:** Every year, the UCCS Digital Filmmaking program produces a three episode anthology television show called The Bluffs. Students write, film, and edit the show from start to finish.

**Logline: **A punk rocker down on his luck and his funds starts rigging bets using UCCS’s new betting app to pay his mounting pile of bills.

**Roles: **

**HAYDEN: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - MALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

A STRUGGLING PUNK ROCK MUSICIAN. REBELLIOUS AND IMPULSIVE, HE IS TORN BETWEEN BEING FINANCIALLY STABLE AND LIVING AN AUTHENTIC PUNK LIFESTYLE ***THIS ROLE REQUIRES SINGING**

**GRACE: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - FEMALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN’S BEST FRIEND, ROOMMATE, AND BANDMATE. SHE IS QUIETLY CONFIDENT AND HAS A STRONG SENSE OF HER OWN MORALS. VERY PUNK.

**DARBY: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - FEMALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN’S COWORKER WHO IS IN A COMPETING PUNK BAND, ALTHOUGH YOU PROBABLY WOULDN’T KNOW THAT BY LOOKING AT HER. VERY BUSINESS MINDED, SHE IS MORE INTERESTED IN BEING A MUSICIAN FOR THE MONEY AND CLOUT THAN FOR THE ARTISTIC EXPRESSION.

**JP: (30-50 YEARS OLD) - MALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN AND DARBY’S BOSS AND THE BRAIN BEHIND UCCS’ NEW BLUFFBETS APP. A MIDDLE-AGED TECH BRO WHO DESPERATELY TRIES TO BE HIP AND APPEAL TO HIS STUDENT EMPLOYEES.

**Production Company:** UCCS Digital Filmmaking Program

**Production Type: **Student Television Show

**Contact Information:** vsmith@uccs.edu

**Run Time: **Television Show, three 10ish minute episdodes

**Compensation: **Unpaid

**Union Status:** Non-Union

**Audition Information:** October 24th from 2 pm to 7 pm at UCCS, by appointment only: 

https://calendly.com/vsmith-uccs/bluffsseason13audition

Shooting Schedule:

October 31st, 9AM-7PM

November 7th, 9AM-7PM

November 14th, 9AM-7PM

November 21st, 9AM-7PM

December 5th, 9AM-7PM

December 12th, 9AM-7PM

December 19th, 9AM-7PM

***Shoot dates called will depend on the role. Please look at each character to see how frequently we expect you to be called based on the character you audition for**

**Filming Location:** Various, mostly on the UCCS campus, every location with be in Colorado Springs.

**Project Description:** Every year, the UCCS Digital Filmmaking program produces a three episode anthology television show called The Bluffs. Students write, film, and edit the show from start to finish.

VANCOUVER CASTING CALL — TWO FEMALE ROLES
We’re seeking two performers who can portray teenage girls, ages 13–19, for an independent short film exploring social issues affecting women. Adults who can convincingly play teens are welcome to apply.

Role 1: Open to all ethnicities

Role 2: Seeking an Indigenous performer

We’re looking for a natural presence and emotional depth. No acting experience or demo reel is required. Please send a short, makeup-free video introducing yourself.

Location: Vancouver

Filming: Two days in early November

Compensation: Unpaid portfolio project. Meals provided on both days.

The film is led by a female director, with a crew of Vancouver Film School graduates currently working in the industry. The director’s previous short received selections and awards across four film festivals in London and the United States. We plan to submit this film to more than 50 festivals.

Please send your introduction video and availability to hiayj23@gmail.com.

Thank you for your interest. Sharing this casting call is appreciated.

items.text: Clowning is not purely for people who wish to be clowns or go into comedy; it's not even purely about ‘making people laugh’. It's a practice that can benefit any creative artist- actor, director, writer, etc.- by enabling them to achieve a level of honesty and playfulness that creates work unique to those who undertake the training

sharedPost.text:
An in-depth, serious and enjoyable exploration into the unlimited power of the state of clown and its impact on new and experienced clowns, actors, performers of all kinds, anyone who stands in front of an audience, and those seeking ways to be in the moment with confidence, authenticity and joy.
This is a transformatory course; by embracing the methodology, you will deepen your ability to enter and stay in the state of clown in whatever context you work. 
Transformation only comes with some effort, and the course is a process that will stretch you, but one based in support, kindness, and a great deal of fun, laughter and play along the way. 
Through led exercises, improvisations, games and explorations, de Castro expertly and safely guides participants through an individual and collective process. It invites you to try new things and make mistakes in a supportive environment. 
Come prepared for challenges and change.
We support and celebrate each participant’s journey of development.
𝗕𝘆 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗲𝗻𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝘀𝗵𝗼𝗽, 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲: 
*explored the pleasure of being present;
*confidence in risk-taking & the freedom to fail ;
*how to use the audience as your partner;
*a strong understanding of your relationship with your 
*own clown persona, that is unique and individual to you;
*a toolbox of well-defined techniques to refine your performance skills on your own and in groups;
*knowledge of how to use clowning in acting, or in any creative work within other disciplines.

Szukamy osób do badania dotyczącego systemów POS w gastronomii 🍽️
Prowadzimy badanie na temat systemów POS i rozwiązań kasowych wykorzystywanych w lokalach gastronomicznych i szukamy osób, które mają praktyczne doświadczenie z ich wyborem lub codziennym użytkowaniem.

👤 Kogo szukamy?

właścicieli lokali gastronomicznych,

managerów,

osób odpowiedzialnych za wybór systemu POS / kasy,

osób, które mają realną wiedzę na temat użytkowanego w lokalu rozwiązania.

💬 Na czym polega badanie?

Zapraszamy na około 60-minutową rozmowę online, podczas której porozmawiamy o doświadczeniach związanych z systemem POS, jego wyborem, użytkowaniem oraz potrzebami lokalu.

Na początku zadamy kilka krótkich pytań, żeby sprawdzić, czy profil uczestnika i lokalu pasuje do założeń badania.

💰 Wynagrodzenie za udział: 300 zł

Jeśli prowadzisz lokal gastronomiczny lub odpowiadasz w nim za system POS i chciał(a)byś podzielić się swoim doświadczeniem, napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej.

Dziękuję! 🙌

�📅 Termin: JUTRO, 18.10 (niedziela)�🕒 Godziny: wieczorne/nocne (nagrania po zmroku)�📍 Lokalizacja: okolice Warszawy�🎭 Rola: DZIEWCZYNKA (klimat horroru)
Zależy nam na niepokojącym, lekko przerażającym sposobie gry – powolne ruchy głową, spokojne, wolne wypowiadanie kwestii, na wzór dzieci z horrorów.

Ze względu na bardzo pilny termin prosimy o przesyłanie zgłoszeń OD RAZU Z NAGRANĄ PRÓBKĄ AKTORSKĄ na podstawie scenki załączonej do posta.

Self-tape może być nagrany telefonem, a kwestie pozostałych postaci czytane zza kamery.

✨ CASTING CALL: THE NORTH POLE EXPERIENCE ✨
FINAL SUBMISSIONS: PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN HEARING FROM:

👨 MALE IDENTIFYING ACTORS.
👩 FEMALE IDENTIFYING ACTOR/SINGERS
💡 LIGHTING / SOUND TECHNICIANS. 

Are you ready to bring the magic of Christmas to life? We are now accepting final submissions for dynamic, warm, and versatile performers for The North Pole Experience in Liverpool! (please note this is suggested for performers local to the North West UK area, travel / accommodation can not be provided). 

We are seeking performers of all genders (18+) for Principal, Supporting, and Operational roles across our festive attractions.

📍 Location: Liverpool (L17), United Kingdom

🎭 Roles: Male and Female identifying Scripted Principal Roles, Unscripted Supporting Roles & Immersive Operational Roles, Technical Roles. 

📆 Contract: Mid-November – Late December

What We’re Looking For
 * Principal Scripted Roles: Previous professional acting experience required.

 * Supporting & Operational Roles: Experience in entertainment or live performance is a plus, but enthusiastic newcomers with a passion for performing are welcome!

* Technical Roles: Lighting & Sound Technician. Experience operating within Chamsys MagicQ. Troubleshooting and problem solving in a fast paced environment. Must have previous professional experience within live events / theatre /. 

 * Personality: Strong, confident acting ability, natural stage warmth, and a true embodiment of the Christmas spirit.

📅 Key Dates (Full Availability Required)
 * Rehearsals: Select dates during week commencing 16th November. Role dependant.

 * Tech Rehearsals: 21st & 22nd November
 * Friends & Family Preview: 27th November
 * Opening weekend: 28th / 29th November 🎅
 * Charity Day: 2nd December (select characters only)
 * Show Days: 5th, 6th, 12th, 13th, 19th, 20th, 21st, 23rd & 24th December
 * Additional Performance Days (Otterspool Grotto - select characters only): 4th, 10th, 11th, 17th & 18th December.

Working hours operate on staggered start and finish times from 8:00am onwards, with finishes from 5:30pm onwards depending on character allocation. Cast members should be prepared for full-day shifts however certain days will have later starts and/or earlier finishes.

💰 Pay & Perks
 * Performance Days: Paid at up to £165 per day (depending on role and experience).
* Technical Roles: Pay discussed with each applicant. 

 * Rehearsal Days: Paid hourly at National Minimum Wage (NMW) for your age group.

 * Perks: Complimentary breakfast, lunch and refreshments provided on all performance days, free tickets for our Friends & Family Preview, plus staff discounts in our on-site merchandise shop.

📩 How to Apply
Please email casting@thenorthpoleexperience.co.uk with the following details:

 * Full Name & Contact Details (Phone number & email address)
 * Confirmation of Full Availability (Please note: We cannot consider applications with partial availability)
 * Relevant Performance/Entertainment Experience (if applicable)
 * Link to Spotlight / Showreel (Please do not attach large video files directly to the email)
 * Current Availability for In-Person Auditions

Help us bring the magic of Christmas to life — we can’t wait to make magic with you! ✨🎄.

www.thenorthpoleexperience.co.uk

items.text:
Call for Participants: Staged Reading Theatre Workshop

Are you an aspiring or experienced actor with lived experience of addiction?

“Saving the Timothy” — A Modern Retelling of “A Christmas Carol”

The Recovered Arts Collective is seeking actors for an upcoming staged reading of Saving the Timothy, a new dramatic comedy written and directed by John-David Hutchison.

We also require Stage Manager, Assistant Director, Lighting & Sound Technicians

About the Project
We are bringing together a community of people with lived experience of addiction to participate in developing this new play. This project will culminate in a staged reading—a live performance where actors read the script with minimal sets, props, or costumes. Performers focus on character development, vocal expression, and text interpretation in a supportive, low-pressure environment.

Logline
A washed-up, addiction-ravaged Hollywood director returns to his small-town Canadian theatre roots to stage A Christmas Carol, where the specter of his late partner forces him through a dark, hallucinatory journey across his past, present, and future toward 12-step redemption and sobriety.

Who Can Join & What to Expect
Inclusive Community: Everyone is welcome! Whether you are a seasoned creative or have never stepped foot on a stage before, no previous experience is required—just a willingness to share your story and connect.

Supportive Environment: A peer-led space focused on safety, creative expression, personal growth, and building lasting relationships.

Collaborative Process: Work together to bring personal and community stories to life, culminating in a public staged reading performance.

Key Dates & Location
Audition / Table Read: Sunday, November 1, 2026, 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Rehearsals: Sundays (November 8, 15, 22, 29), 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Performance: Sunday, December 6, 2026 (Time TBD)
Location: The Vancouver Recovery Club, 2775 Sophia St, Vancouver, BC

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Character Breakdown
Eban Miser: A once-prominent Broadway and Hollywood director who, after facing bankruptcy, career failure, and struggles with alcoholism and drug addiction, returns to his hometown to direct a local production of A Christmas Carol and undergoes a redemptive journey toward sobriety.

Jake O'Connor/The Ghost of Christmas Future: Eban's late business partner and co-founder of the Timothy Findley Theatre, who dies broke and unaccomplished, but happy and whose reanimated corpse warns Eban to change his destructive path.

Bob Cratchit: Eban's loyal and hardworking stage manager at the theatre, who later becomes an equal partner and helps care for Timothia.

Fred: Eban's cheerful and persistent nephew who repeatedly invites him to holiday gatherings and tries to show him goodwill.

Clara: Fred's wife and member of the theatre troupe

Bill (The Ghost of Christmas Past): A calm, guiding figure who leads Eban through his spectral journey 

Fan: Eban's late sister.

Mr. Fezziwig: Eban's enthusiastic high school gym teacher who features in his past memory of a school dance.

Patricia: Eban's former fiancée who broke off their relationship because he abandoned their shared values for the pursuit of wealth.

Belle: Eban's former partner who left him because of his unaddressed alcoholism.

Emily: Bob Cratchit's sharp-tongued wife who helps run the household and cares for Timothia.

Timothia: Jake’s sullen 15-year-old orphaned daughter who lives with Bob and Emily.

Jack: The abusive stepfather from Eban's childhood.

Craig: Belle's husband.

Nancy, Topper, and Friends: Members of the theatre troupe
Roastmaster and 3 Roast Comics: Roasters of Eban (These four roles are specifically for comedians who will assist in the writing of the roast dialogue.)

This is a volunteer opportunity and you must be committed to the rehearsal schedule.

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Casting selection will be through the table read.

Questions? Reach out to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org with the subject line "Staged Reading Inquiry."

Jigsaw Casting is seeking Canadian User -generated videos that show a ‘winning moment’ in life for a LOTTO 649 campaign done through TBWA\Canada (address: 219 Dufferin Street, Suite 302C, Toronto, ON, M6K 3J1/Tel: 416.483.3600/[https://tbwa.ca/](https://tbwa.ca/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFaZzlmNFdiS1JOMTRibVNkc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHifDGia4LsOANDG_Ih2ltQT9AaeTz2u2uhuNe4hNlIgkWLvv1Kcxh0Qp2M2Z_aem_X_R1CiZkB1duyws1Eg9Ziw)) (Excludes submissions from the province of Quebec)

We are looking for those moments that feel like someone is coming out on top. Your video clips should have a range of emotions. Some are fist pumping celebrations (i.e. catching a baseball). Others are beautiful, heartfelt moments (i.e. someone asking out his crush and getting her number, or someone getting married and it was a very emotional romantic moment).

We’ll prioritize a broad range of Canadian experiences and affinities, from fishing and outdoor activities to sports, city moments, friendships, family and romantic relationships.

Canadian-shot content only: All footage must be filmed in Canada. Canadian creators are preferred, and recognizable non-Canadian locations/backdrops should be avoided. Generic footage from a Canadian creator that does not reveal an identifiable foreign location may be considered subject to client approval.

What we are looking for:

Our clips also fall into two camps: The Win and The Agency.

The Win
This shows the moment people come out on top.
For example:
→ Pulling a giant trout from the water
→ Catching a home run baseball in the stands

The Agency
This shows a moment of doubt, hesitation, or choice.
→ A moment before their hole-in-one swing, a friend saying they can’t make the shot.
→ Someone getting egged on before they go on stage and slay at karaoke.
→ Someone is deliberating doing that cliff dive. Do they vs don’t they.

If you have another footage that is a wild card, it may not fit the above specs, you can still submit it.

The selected videos would be used for our LOTTO 649 campaign. This is a non-union project. If your video is chosen, you will be paid $2,500.00 per video.

Permissions:
Submitted videos must have been shot prior to October 14, 2026.
The person who has filmed the video has granted permission for the video to appear in the ad on TV and online.
All talent who appears in the video are cleared and grant permission for the video to be used

Here’s a top line of things to avoid:
No one under 25 and no children of any age in the video clips.
Nothing that could be perceived as appealing to children. This is a bit nebulous, we know, so use your best judgement.
Nothing that comes across as specifically American.
No alcohol is shown in the clip.

Submissions are due ASAP or before: October 28 at 11am EST.

If interested, you must upload your video(s)to be considered to:
https://lotto649ugc.castingcrane.com/

🎬 **CASTING CALL – A MISTAKE (Short Film)**

Hi everyone! We're looking for two actors for our upcoming **7-minute short film**, *A Mistake*, shooting in Central Burnaby on **October 29**.

**LOGLINE**
Two friends bond over the struggles of dating and being single while on a hike, but things take an awkward turn when one jokingly suggests they start dating each other and the other doesn't take it well.

**ROLES**

**BEN | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**
A bit awkward, literal, and straightforward, with a dry sense of humour. Ben and Sarah were friends in high school but drifted apart after graduation. He's been single for a while and figures he has nothing to lose by jokingly suggesting they start dating, but the conversation takes an unexpected turn.

**SARAH | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**
Outgoing and sociable, Sarah works as a schoolteacher and has an easy warmth about her. She's been single for a while and struggles to process or identify what she's feeling, particularly when it comes to relationships. She and Ben were friends in high school but drifted apart before reconnecting after college. The hike serves as a chance for them to catch up.

**PRODUCTION DETAILS**
📍 Location: Central Burnaby, BC
📅 Shoot date: October 29, 2026
💰 Compensation: Volunteer, with demo reel material, photos, IMDb credit, and food provided on set
🎭 Open to UBCP/ACTRA members and non-union performers
📩 Submission deadline: October 20, 2026

**HOW TO APPLY**
Please email your headshot, demo reel (if available), and resume to **amistakeshortfilm@gmail.com**. We are also open to first time actors and those who have had no formal training. 

Use the subject line: **[Your Name] – [Character Name] Audition**

Shortlisted applicants will receive **self-tape instructions**. Feel free to share with anyone who might be a good fit. Thanks!

**BALTIMORE ACTORS WORKSHOP**

**Ongoing Every Monday 7-10 pm** **$40 per mo. (4 classes)**

**Your First Class Free.** Bring a monologue, 2-3 min. At any stage of development. Not required.

**Monologues, Scenes, Exercises, Work on your Craft.**

Musikalisches 🎶 „fill-in“ beim Förderkreis des historischen Dampfschiffes „Prinz Heinrich“ zum gemütlichen Beisammensein an Bord gemeinsam mit Reinhard Haffke am Schlagzeug. Erst die Musik mit Country 🪕 und augenzwinkernd vorgetragenem Liedgut der 50erJahre (auch der „Bordchor“ mischte super 👍🏼 mit !), dann das furiose Feuerwerk🎇 auf dem Leeraner Hafen anlässlich des Gallimarktes. Was ein Genuss!
Danke 🙏🏽 für die Einladung; vanabend geiht wieder up de „Prinz Heinrich“ zur Lampion-Fahrt up de Hafen: Heel wat Besünners! 
 @Top-Fans

Casting is changing. Storytelling is evolving. New opportunities are emerging for actors. 🔗 ⬇️ 

But how do we navigate this changing landscape?

This Thursday, we’re joined LIVE by Emmy-nominated casting director Bonnie Rodini, whose career spans Netflix’s One Piece, the seven-award-winning independent film Good Life, and the viral vertical comedy series Shambles.

Bonnie brings a perspective that goes far beyond casting.

Join us for a conversation about the changing industry, the opportunities emerging for actors, and what we need to understand to move our careers forward.

🎭 LIVE MASTERCLASS & Q&A 

📅 Thursday, 22 October
⏰ 7 PM BST
📍 Live on Zoom

FREE REGISTRATION

🔗 https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1fIYwwt38kf7dudIbKCGO74fuNR5TafYyk1yov03mb2I/viewform

Title: *I’m Going to Beat You to Death With the Cuck Chair*

Genre: Comedy

Logline: When Douglas’s wife wants to experiment inside their relationship, he begrudgingly accepts and ends up heckled by the very chair that he is stuck sitting in. 

Roles: 

**DOUGLAS - LEAD** - *Male, 20s-40s*

A man being cucked by his own wife, much to his dismay. Drops acid and starts being heckled by the chair that he’s stuck sitting on.

**RACHEL - SUPPORTING** - *Female, 20s-40s*

Douglas’s enthusiastic, but dismissive wife, looking for a little excitement.

**CLARA - SUPPORTING** - *Female, 20s-40s*

A trash-talking, dominant sex worker, helping give Rachel a new experience.

**CHAIR - LEAD** **(VO) **- *Male, any age*

A talking chair that heckles Douglas through his entire awkward experience. VO only.

Director: Xander Raley

Production Type: Short Film

Contact Information: sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com

Run Time: Short

Compensation: Unpaid; snacks and meals will be provided, as well as a copy of final film and footage.

**[ZLECENIE PŁATNE, CYKLICZNE]**

**WARSZAWA — CASTING DO SPEKTAKLU KOMEDIOWEGO**

Do nowego, niezależnego spektaklu komediowego z elementami interakcji z publicznością (dorosłą) szukamy **zawodowego aktora i zawodowej aktorki** do dwóch głównych ról.

**Szukamy wyłącznie osób mieszkających w Warszawie**, dostępnych na miejscu do prób i współpracy.

Interesuje nas humor sytuacyjny, precyzja i umiejętność słuchania partnera. Szukamy osób, które potrafią być zabawne, traktując swoją postać i jej problemy zupełnie serio.

**WIKTOR** — pewny siebie entuzjasta technologii i samozwańczy wizjoner. Modny, zadbany, bussiness casual w wieku 30-40 lat. Chce uchodzić za człowieka, który wszystko rozumie pierwszy. Im mniej kontroluje sytuację, tym bardziej przekonująco ją wyjaśnia. Lekko zmanieryzowany.

**ADA** — aspirująca ekspertka technologiczna, świeżo po studiach. Ambitna, ciekawa świata, bardzo chce sprostać zadaniu. Wiedzę dopiero zdobywa, a brak pewności próbuje przykrywać fachowym językiem.

Szukamy osób z **zawodowym doświadczeniem scenicznym**, szczególnie z wyczuciem komedii i swobodą w kontakcie z publicznością. Zależy nam na gotowości do współtworzenia roli podczas prób.

Planujemy długoterminową współpracę. Terminy spektakli będą nieregularne, zależne od zamówień. Praca zawsze w tygodniu, weekendy wolne.

**Wynagrodzenie do ustalenia na castingu, ale minimum 1000 zł/ spektakl. **Spektakl trwa około 2 godzin: godzinę stanowią sceny oparte na scenariuszu, a pozostałą część — prowadzone w rolach interakcje i zabawy z publicznością, z przestrzenią na improwizację. **Materiał tekstowy do przygotowania obejmuje więc około godziny przedstawienia.**

**ZGŁOSZENIA W KOMENTARZACH POD POSTEM LUB MAILOWO NA: **spolkazograniczonao@gmail.com

Prosimy podać:
* Rolę, do której się zgłaszasz: **Wiktor / Ada**.
* **Link do wideo pokazującego Twoją grę aktorską.**
* Link do portfolio lub krótkiego CV aktorskiego. Jeśli nie posiadasz, nagraj nam krótki selftape i opowiedz o sobie i swoim doświadczeniu aktorskim.

**Nagranie jest najważniejszym elementem zgłoszenia. Zgłoszeń bez linku do wideo pokazującego grę aktorską nie będziemy rozpatrywać.**

Może to być istniejąca scena, fragment spektaklu lub showreel — nie wymagamy przygotowania nowego nagrania. Najlepiej wskaż 1–2 minuty, które mamy obejrzeć. Sprawdź, czy link działa i materiał jest dostępny bez proszenia o uprawnienia.

**Termin zgłoszeń: wtorek, 20.10.2026, do godz. 23:59.**

**Casting stacjonarny dla wybranych osób: czwartek, 22.10.2026, Warszawa.**

Z wybranymi osobami skontaktujemy się prywatnie. Prześlemy fragment scenariusza, szczegółowe warunki współpracy oraz adres i indywidualną godzinę spotkania.

Może to być istniejąca scena, fragment spektaklu lub showreel — nie wymagamy przygotowania nowego nagrania. Najlepiej wskaż 1–2 minuty, które mamy obejrzeć. Sprawdź, czy link działa i materiał jest dostępny bez proszenia o uprawnienia.

**Termin zgłoszeń: wtorek, 20.10.2026, do godz. 23:59.**

**Casting stacjonarny dla wybranych osób: czwartek, 22.10.2026, Warszawa.**

Z wybranymi osobami skontaktujemy się prywatnie. Prześlemy fragment scenariusza, szczegółowe warunki współpracy oraz adres i indywidualną godzinę spotkania.

items.text:
Masaż Lomi Lomi – nie musisz czekać na urlop, żeby naprawdę odpocząć

Czasem myślimy o odpoczynku jak o czymś dużym: tygodniu na plaży, wyjeździe w góry, kilku dniach bez telefonu. Takie chwile są piękne i potrzebne, ale nie zawsze możemy sobie na nie pozwolić wtedy, kiedy najbardziej ich potrzebujemy. I wtedy masaż, podczas którego możesz odłożyć codzienność na bok, przychodzi Ci z pomocą.

Masaż Lomi Lomi wywodzi się z tradycji hawajskiej i wyróżnia się płynnymi ruchami, często wykonywanymi przedramionami. Dotyk jest szeroki i otulający, a ruchy płynnie przechodzą jedne w drugie. Dzięki temu masaż może przypominać spokojny rytm fal – bez gwałtownych zmian, bez pośpiechu, bez konieczności kontrolowania każdego kolejnego momentu.

To doświadczenie, w którym możesz pozwolić sobie nie zastanawiać się, co będzie za pięć minut. Nie prowadzić rozmowy, nie szukać rozwiązań ani nie układać w głowie planu na jutro. Możesz skupić się na tym, co dzieje się tu i teraz: na cieple, rytmie dotyku, kontakcie z własnym ciałem i oddechu, który z czasem być może stanie się spokojniejszy.

Nie musisz przychodzić na masaż z konkretnym problemem. Nie musisz nawet wiedzieć, czego dokładnie potrzebujesz. Czasami wystarczy poczucie, że od dłuższego czasu jesteś dla wszystkich, tylko nie dla siebie.

Jeśli czujesz, że potrzebujesz przerwy, zapraszamy Cię do Gabinetu Czas Relaksu na masaż Lomi Lomi. Stworzymy Ci przestrzeń, w której możesz zwolnić, odetchnąć i na chwilę odsunąć od siebie codzienne obowiązki.

✨ CASTING CALL: THE NORTH POLE EXPERIENCE ✨
FINAL SUBMISSIONS: PARTICULARLY INTERESTED IN HEARING FROM:

👨 MALE IDENTIFYING ACTORS.
👩 FEMALE IDENTIFYING ACTOR/SINGERS
💡 LIGHTING / SOUND TECHNICIANS. 

Are you ready to bring the magic of Christmas to life? We are now accepting final submissions for dynamic, warm, and versatile performers for The North Pole Experience in Liverpool! (please note this is suggested for performers local to the North West UK area, travel / accommodation can not be provided). 

We are seeking performers of all genders (18+) for Principal, Supporting, and Operational roles across our festive attractions.

📍 Location: Liverpool (L17), United Kingdom

🎭 Roles: Male and Female identifying Scripted Principal Roles, Unscripted Supporting Roles & Immersive Operational Roles, Technical Roles. 

📆 Contract: Mid-November – Late December

What We’re Looking For
 * Principal Scripted Roles: Previous professional acting experience required.

 * Supporting & Operational Roles: Experience in entertainment or live performance is a plus, but enthusiastic newcomers with a passion for performing are welcome!

* Technical Roles: Lighting & Sound Technician. Experience operating within Chamsys MagicQ. Troubleshooting and problem solving in a fast paced environment. Must have previous professional experience within live events / theatre /. 

 * Personality: Strong, confident acting ability, natural stage warmth, and a true embodiment of the Christmas spirit.

📅 Key Dates (Full Availability Required)
 * Rehearsals: Select dates during week commencing 16th November. Role dependant.

 * Tech Rehearsals: 21st & 22nd November
 * Friends & Family Preview: 27th November
 * Opening weekend: 28th / 29th November 🎅
 * Charity Day: 2nd December (select characters only)
 * Show Days: 5th, 6th, 12th, 13th, 19th, 20th, 21st, 23rd & 24th December
 * Additional Performance Days (Otterspool Grotto - select characters only): 4th, 10th, 11th, 17th & 18th December.

Working hours operate on staggered start and finish times from 8:00am onwards, with finishes from 5:30pm onwards depending on character allocation. Cast members should be prepared for full-day shifts however certain days will have later starts and/or earlier finishes.

💰 Pay & Perks
 * Performance Days: Paid at up to £165 per day (depending on role and experience).
* Technical Roles: Pay discussed with each applicant. 

 * Rehearsal Days: Paid hourly at National Minimum Wage (NMW) for your age group.

 * Perks: Complimentary breakfast, lunch and refreshments provided on all performance days, free tickets for our Friends & Family Preview, plus staff discounts in our on-site merchandise shop.

📩 How to Apply
Please email casting@thenorthpoleexperience.co.uk with the following details:

 * Full Name & Contact Details (Phone number & email address)
 * Confirmation of Full Availability (Please note: We cannot consider applications with partial availability)
 * Relevant Performance/Entertainment Experience (if applicable)
 * Link to Spotlight / Showreel (Please do not attach large video files directly to the email)
 * Current Availability for In-Person Auditions

Help us bring the magic of Christmas to life — we can’t wait to make magic with you! ✨🎄.

www.thenorthpoleexperience.co.uk

Announcing auditions for:

The Savannah Sipping Society

By Jones Hope Wooten

Directed by Ben Green 

Auditions: Monday & Tuesday, October 26 & 27 @ 7:00pm

Callbacks by invitation Wednesday, October 28th @ 7:00pm

Please bring a headshot and resume and be prepared to read from the script

Please be prepared to list any and all conflicts

A hilarious, heartfelt comedy about friendship, second chances, and starting over. Four very different Southern women find themselves at a crossroads in life. After an unexpected meeting at a yoga class, they come together for an impromptu happy hour that blossoms into a weekly gathering filled with laughter, cocktails, romantic misadventures, and life-changing revelations. As they navigate personal setbacks and unexpected new beginnings, these women discover that it’s never too late to reinvent yourself—or find your people.

We are seeking four dynamic performers with strong comedic instincts, excellent timing, and the ability to balance broad comedy with genuine emotional depth. Distinct Southern character voices are required.

Performances: January 8 through 31, 2027

Thurs–Sat at 7:30pm

Sundays at 2:00pm

Saturday matinees January 16th and 30th at 2:00pm

Rehearsals at Cabrillo Playhouse in San Clemente, CA

We welcome and encourage performers of ALL races, ages, gender identities, abilities, body types and ethnicities to audition.

There is a $100 stipend offered

All audition info can be found at [https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/](https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFycU1rOXdWUVQ3NVYwZTd5c3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHm2Tb8clJTpxO68zuvsQvksB_no2fy_0RkndZIF5-lmcuKAEritfk1H60_jt_aem_lUoHhYxjNHwOwByN68UZcg)

Announcing auditions for:

The Savannah Sipping Society

By Jones Hope Wooten

Directed by Ben Green 

Auditions: Monday & Tuesday, October 26 & 27 @ 7:00pm

Callbacks by invitation Wednesday, October 28th @ 7:00pm

Please bring a headshot and resume and be prepared to read from the script

Please be prepared to list any and all conflicts

A hilarious, heartfelt comedy about friendship, second chances, and starting over. Four very different Southern women find themselves at a crossroads in life. After an unexpected meeting at a yoga class, they come together for an impromptu happy hour that blossoms into a weekly gathering filled with laughter, cocktails, romantic misadventures, and life-changing revelations. As they navigate personal setbacks and unexpected new beginnings, these women discover that it’s never too late to reinvent yourself—or find your people.

We are seeking four dynamic performers with strong comedic instincts, excellent timing, and the ability to balance broad comedy with genuine emotional depth. Distinct Southern character voices are required.

Performances: January 8 through 31, 2027

Thurs–Sat at 7:30pm

Sundays at 2:00pm

Saturday matinees January 16th and 30th at 2:00pm

Rehearsals at Cabrillo Playhouse in San Clemente, CA

We welcome and encourage performers of ALL races, ages, gender identities, abilities, body types and ethnicities to audition.

There is a $100 stipend offered

All audition info can be found at [https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/](https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFycU1rOXdWUVQ3NVYwZTd5c3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHm2Tb8clJTpxO68zuvsQvksB_no2fy_0RkndZIF5-lmcuKAEritfk1H60_jt_aem_lUoHhYxjNHwOwByN68UZcg)

We are currently looking for up to four actors to participate in our upcoming twilight spooky rides.
Here are the details for the position:

  - Dates: October 22, 23, 24, 29, 30, and 31

  - Hours: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM (2 hours per day)

  - Pay: $50 per day (paid in cash)

  - Location: Silver Lake Railriders, 1381 Village Road, Silver Lake, NH 03875 (behind the Silver Lake Railroad Station)

Schedule & Responsibilities:

  - Station Actor (1): Remains at the station area and yard to haunt the arriving guests.

  - Trail Actors (3): At 4:00 PM, a rail motorcar will drop three actors off at designated acting locations along the route.

  - The Performance: The twilight railbike ride departs at 4:30 PM. Actors will scare guests on their way out and back. The rail motorcar will pick up the trail actors at the end of the run, returning everyone to the station around 6:00 PM for a final scare.

Requirements:

  - Safety rules must be strictly followed: no touching riders and maintain a safe distance from all equipment.

  - All actors (or parents/guardians for minors) must sign a standard liability release prior to participating.

I have created a spreadsheet to help organize and schedule interested actors. You can learn more about us at slrailriders.com.

Best regards,

Hank Walther

🎭 THERE’S STILL ROOM FOR YOU IN THE CRUCIBLE! ❤️

Come be part of something meaningful!
Our auditions are almost full, but there are still so many ways to get involved in our exciting community theatre production of The Crucible, coming to Ottawa’s Gladstone Theatre in February 2027!
Whether you’ve never set foot in a theatre or have years of professional experience, we’d love to hear from you!
No experience necessary! And to those with experience, knowledge, and expertise to share, your volunteer contributions would be enormously valued.
We also believe this experience has something wonderful to offer everyone who participates.

❤️ MORE THAN A PLAY
Arthur Miller wrote The Crucible in 1953 as a parable for McCarthyism and the fear, accusations, and political persecution of his time.
We believe it can also serve as a powerful parable for the times we’re living in today.
Through this production, we’ll explore questions about fear, power, conformity, courage, conscience, and what happens when communities turn against one another.
We’re not here to tell people what to think. We’re creating space to think, question, discuss, and explore together.
And, of course, to create some wonderful theatre along the way!

🌟 HOW CAN YOU GET INVOLVED?
🎭 Onstage: Non-speaking roles, ensemble performers, and understudies.

🎨 Creative & Technical: Sets, props, costumes, construction, painting, hair and makeup, lighting, sound, and backstage crew.

🎬 Production Support: Stage management, rehearsal assistance, volunteer coordination, transportation, logistics, photography, and video.

📣 Marketing & Community: Social media, postering, publicity, creating our online program, finding sponsors, connecting with local TV, radio, newspapers and podcasts, and community outreach.

❤️ Special Opportunities: Helping organize our intergenerational performance for seniors and high school students, supporting special lobby activities, accessibility and participant support, and other helping hands!

Have a talent or idea we haven’t mentioned? Tell us!

📅 COME MEET US!
Tuesday, October 20 at 6:00 p.m.

📍 All Saints Westboro
347 Richmond Road, Ottawa
This is an opportunity for people interested in non-speaking roles and behind-the-scenes involvement to meet us and learn more about the production.

Please email us in advance to let us know you’re coming. No drop-ins, please!

💌 connect@nataliefraser.ca
Include your name, phone number, areas of interest, any experience or skills you’d like to share, your general availability, and whether you’ll attend October 20.

Can’t make October 20? That’s absolutely fine! Email us anyway, and we’ll invite you to join us on November 1.
🗓️ WHAT ABOUT THE COMMITMENT?
Rehearsals will generally take place on Wednesdays and Sundays, but not everyone will be needed every week. There will also be some full-cast and crew days, with details shared as we develop the rehearsal schedule.

❤️ WHY BE PART OF IT?
Because community theatre is about more than putting on a show.
It’s about people of different ages, backgrounds, and experiences coming together. Sharing skills. Learning new things. Building friendships. Challenging ourselves. Having fun. And creating something that matters.
Whether you come to learn, to share your expertise, to meet new people, or because the themes of this play speak to you, we hope you’ll find something meaningful in the experience too.
The Crucible was a parable for Miller’s time. What might it reveal about ours?
Let’s explore that together!

🎭 THE CRUCIBLE
February 17–20, 2027
The Gladstone Theatre, Ottawa
Unedited Woman Productions
Come for the theatre. Stay for the community. Be part of the conversation. ❤️

#TheCrucible #OttawaTheatre #CommunityTheatre #OttawaVolunteers #UneditedWomanProductions #TheGladstone #VolunteerOttawa

1.Iwona (41) – kobieta po stracie dziecka, załamana, rozbita, wrak człowieka. Chorobliwie szczupła i zniszczona problemami.  

Data: 30.10

Stawka: 700 zł netto

2. Joanna (37) - przecietna kobieta z przemocowej rodziny, wystraszona.

Data: 27.10

Stawka: 800 zl netto

3. Miłosz (46) – adopcyjny ojciec, przeciętny facet zniszczony życiem, w depresji.  

Data: 26.10

Stawka: 800 zł netto

4.Lekarz (61) – konkretny i rzeczowy lekarz, zadbany 

Data: 27.10

Stawka: 500 zł netto

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:

1. Wiek/wzrost/waga

2. Nr tel. do kontaktu

3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)

4. Aktualne zdjęcie

5. Krótki opis doświadczenia

6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich

7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku

8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

items.text:
Cześć!!! 🎬🎥
Do najnowszego odcinka Trudnych Spraw, poszukiwane Kobiety:

1.HALINA BARTOSZEK (56 l.) – matka Edyty

SCENY: 1, 4, 7, 23 INTRO: 2

WYGLĄD: Zadbana kobieta po pięćdziesiątce.

SZCZEGÓŁY: Bezpośrednia, emocjonalna i zaangażowana w życie córki. Opiekuńcza, ale przejmuje się opinią innych i potrafi być oceniająca.

📆29-30.10

2.JUSTYNA CICHOCKA (25 l.) – siostra Pawła

SCENY: 24, 25, 26, 27

WYGLĄD: Młoda, naturalna dziewczyna wzbudzająca sympatię.

SZCZEGÓŁY: Mocno związana z bratem, emocjonalna i zdeterminowana. Od miesiąca szuka zaginionego Pawła.

📆 28 i 30.10

3.PAULINA KRAWCZUK (31 l.) – żona Damiana

SCENY: 1, 20 INTRO: 3

WYGLĄD: Kobieta w dziewiątym miesiącu ciąży, ekspresyjna i temperamentna.

SZCZEGÓŁY: Zdradzona żona Damiana. Bezpośrednia, wybuchowa i bardzo emocjonalna; potrzebna aktorka wiarygodna w ostrych scenach konfrontacyjnych.

📆29.10

4.SĄSIADKA (60 l.) – lokatorka z bloku Edyty i Pawła

SCENY: 16, 21

WYGLĄD: Zwyczajna kobieta około 60 lat, typ mieszkanki osiedla.

SZCZEGÓŁY: Ciekawska, bezpośrednia, dobrze zorientowana w tym, co dzieje się na osiedlu.

📆29.10

5.MATKA (35 l.) – matka przedszkolaka, którego uczy EdytaSCENA: 3 INTRO: 1

WYGLĄD: Zadbana, zwyczajna młoda matka.

Mile widziana Pani z dzieckiem 4/5lat

topComments.text: If this company uses AI slop for their posters, how badly are they going to treat their other artists?

Please don't use #AIslop for casting calls. 🙁
AI is MURDERING HUMAN BEINGS. If that's not reason enough to stop using it, I don't know what is. 💔
#AIslop should not be used by Casting professionals and other industry pros, to officially communicate with actors, either as casting calls, promo posts, advertisements or other messages.
The simple facts that AI was founded on the STOLEN work of actors and other artists; and has become such a volatile disruptor of our entire industry, causing the loss of jobs, the cheapening of our art form, not to mention the very real destruction of our environment, which MOST artists care deeply about...
That alone should be enough for the pros to acknowledge and be sensitive to the fact that using the technology is disrespectful to the actors they work with.

🎬 CASTING CALL: Extras Needed for Music Video Shoot 🎬
Non-Union | Unpaid | No Previous Experience Required

Hello everyone! My name is Jamison Horne. I am a film student at Depaul University and My friends and I are filming a music video for an up-and-coming artist, and we’d love for you to be part of it! We’re looking for about 30 faces to help fill out a crowd scene.

📅 When: Monday, November 2, 2026

⏰ Call Time: 12:00 PM 

📍 Where: Downtown Chicago (exact address sent once you’re confirmed)

✨ Who we’re looking for:

Everyone! All backgrounds, styles, and personalities (18+). No previous experience required. Just bring good energy. If you’ve got the day off, come spend it with us on set!

👕 What to wear: ALL GREY

Any shade, any style: hoodies, sweats, coats, whatever you love. November in Chicago gets chilly, so please bundle up!

💛 What we’re offering:

🍕 Food and snacks to keep you fueled all day

🎥 A spot in the final music video

🎬 A fun, behind-the-scenes look at a real production

A few things to know:

This is a non-union, unpaid, zero-budget passion project, so we’re not able to cover transportation, parking, or other costs. Please plan your own way to and from set. 

If you would like to be composited into a 3D world for free, and for experience purposes, feel welcomed to join. 

🙌 Want to join us?

Fill out the form below if you’re available on Nov 2. Friends are welcome too, just send them this form and bring them along!

We can’t wait to create something amazing together. Please share with anyone who might be interested! 💫

***Only 12 spots left for auditions on Tuesday!***

**CASTING NOTICE**

Non-Equity Call; $50/performance

Trinity Theatre Company is seeking actors to fill all roles for *POTUS* by Selina Fillinger, directed by Kandace Crystal and performing January 8-17, 2027. Also seeking actors to fill most roles in the world premier of The House Between by Serhat Pala, directed by Sean Boyd and performing February 26 - March 14, 2027.

**Auditions:** In-Person appointments on October 20th. Please prepare a 1-2 minute monologue of your choice. Submissions are being taken online through [Sign Up Genius](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions). All submissions must be submitted through this platform. ([https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions))

Prior to auditions, you will be emailed to submit a *digital *copy of your headshot & resume. Hard copies are not required, and will not be taken.

**Important Dates for *****POTUS***:

December 1 – First Rehearsal

December 29 - January 7 – Tech

January 8 - January 17 – Performances

****Break for Christmas Week and New Year Holidays****

**Important Dates for *****The House Between***:

January 12 – First Rehearsal

February 16-25 – Tech

February 26 - March 14 – Performances

**Location:**

All Rehearsals & Performances will take place at the Trinity Theatre Company, 9520 Padgett Street, Suite 208, San Diego, CA 92126

Rehearsals Tuesdays - Fridays from 6p-10p.

Performances Fridays & Saturdays at 7p; Sundays at 2p.

**Character Breakdown:**

****Actors of all ethnicities, race, age, and gender are encouraged to apply****

POTUS:

HARRIET - His Chief of Staff

JEAN - His press secretary

STEPHANIE - His secretary

DUSTY - His dalliance

BERNADETTE - His sister

CHRIS - A journalist

MARGARET - His wife. The First Lady.

THE HOUSE BETWEEN:

CHRISSY -Greek–Australian. 50s–60s.

A painter and mother living in Melbourne. Warm, witty, and emotionally brave beneath a practiced competence. Carries the “unfinished story” of her grandfather and a restless need to stand inside the place it began.

JOHN -Chrissy’s son. Late 20s–30s.

Protective, skeptical, articulate. Thinks structurally (risk, logistics, consequences). His love often arrives as interrogation first, tenderness second.

ATHENA -Chrissy’s daughter. 20s

Bright, affectionate, and perceptive. The first to offer warmth, the quickest to name what’s happening in the room; often the bridge between generations.

HAKAN -Turkish–American. 50s–60s.

An academic (a professor). Disciplined, cerebral, private; until the right silence breaks him open. He’s spent a lifetime explaining history; now he has to live inside it. His emotional center is steadier than he expects.

ARDA - THIS ROLE HAS BEEN CAST - Hakan’s son. 20s.

Startup founder building AI; ambitious, fast, sincere. Wants speed and scale, but still shows up when family becomes real. Capable of surprising gentleness. Special connection to father, almost the Hakan that could have been.

SAM -Hakan’s longtime friend. 50s–60s.

Semi-retired executive / mentor type. Warm, dry, and socially fluent; he can defuse tension without minimizing it. A steady witness - sometimes a referee, sometimes a catalyst.

IRFAN -Local fixer/contractor/paperwork operator. 40s–50s.

An indispensable “solver” who sells solutions and then invents them. Big-hearted, opportunistic, funny without being a clown. Carries a tape measure like a sword. Wants to be essential (and paid). Often the play’s pressure-valve, but with real stakes underneath. Not meant to be a cartoonish character with more substance than quickly visible on the surface.

METIN - Local falcon enthusiast / informal guide. Age flexible (30s–70s).

Arrives with tea and an overstuffed “logbook” energy. Speaks in folk-poetic metaphor that lands more deeply than he intends. Slightly mystical, slightly practical, like the town itself.

*About the Shows:*

***POTUS - ***One four-letter word is about to rock 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue. When the President unwittingly spins a PR nightmare into a global crisis, the seven brilliant and beleaguered women he relies upon most risk life, liberty, and the pursuit of sanity to keep the commander-in-chief out of trouble.

***The House Between ***- “The House Between” is about two immigrants drawn to the same ruined house from opposite histories. Chrissy, a Greek-Australian artist, and Hakan, a Turkish-American historian, meet in Ayvalık, Türkiye, and begin a late-in-life love story shaped by memory, family, and displacement. The play asks: when you carry more than one home inside you, how do you choose where you belong?

🎤❤️ Musik verbindet – Menschen, Herzen und Traditionen! ❤️🎶

Beim wunderschönen Gesangswettbewerb „Lichtkegel“ durften wir Katinka kennenlernen. ✨ Sie hat uns erzählt, wie ihre musikalische Reise begann und was sie ganz besonders macht: das Jodeln! 🏔️🎵

In einer Zeit, in der Volksmusik leider nicht mehr überall im Mittelpunkt steht, finden wir es umso schöner, dass es Menschen wie Katinka gibt, die diese besondere musikalische Tradition mit so viel Leidenschaft und Herz weiterleben. ❤️🎶

Vielen Dank, liebe Katinka, für diesen wunderbaren Einblick in deine musikalische Welt! 🥰

👉 Noch viel mehr gibt es auf unserem JSW Fernsehen YouTube-Kanal! Dort findet ihr das komplette Interview mit Katinka sowie unseren gesamten Beitrag mit vielen weiteren wunderbaren Sängerinnen und Sängern. Freut euch auf tolle Begegnungen, bewegende Geschichten und jede Menge Musik! 🎤🎼

📺 JSW Fernsehen
📻 Radio Heimat – Musik mit Herz! ❤️

https://youtu.be/_kUUv1bjymI?is=ZBt0vCGU6rVx-Sv7

✨ Wir verbinden Musik, Unterhaltung und Menschen – mit Herz, Leidenschaft und ganz viel Gefühl! ✨

#JSWFernsehen #RadioHeimat #MusikMitHerz #Lichtkegel #Katinka #Jodeln #Volksmusik #TraditionBewahren #MusikVerbindet #MusikMitLeidenschaft #Gesangswettbewerb #Musikliebe #SängerinnenUndSänger #Heimatliebe #MusikUndUnterhaltung #YouTubeKanal #MenschenMitHerz #KulturUndTradition 🎶❤️

**Updated Casting and Crew Call for Don't Go Yet. Extras, remaining speaking roles, voice actors and crew needed!**

Please see attached previous post for questions on anything not included in this update. 

**Updates**

Dates and Locations – November 7th and 8th in Wheat Ridge. November 14th and 15th in Westminster.

**Crew Call**

Production Assistant 

Camera PA/2nd AC

Reach out to [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) with any questions.

**Extras!**

Dates and Location – We need around 10 – 15 extras for the weekend of November 14th and 15th in Westminster.

Description - Ages 25 – 38, any race, any gender for what will be a house party scene along with a crowd reacting to a garage band perform.

Contact – Please email [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) if interested!

Compensation – All extras will be fed snacks and meals on the days they are present.

**Supporting Roles Not Cast Yet **

Alec – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s (any race) – College buddy of Connor’s. Smaller in size. Timid and has trouble sticking up for himself. Is always in the circle but has trouble getting a word in.

Katie – Supporting – Late 20’s to early 30s (any race) – Adam’s on again off again girlfriend. Promiscuous and likes to have a good time when it comes to partying. Her and Adam have a complicated relationship but once Adam puts his famous charm on, she runs back every time.

Compensation – All roles will be fed snacks and meals on the days they are present along with credit on the film.  

**Bit ****Parts**

Female Child – 8 to 11 years old (any race) – Need a child to play a girl scout with one line of dialogue. This part will equate to around 1-2 hours of work.

Mother of girl scout – 35 – 45 years old (same race as child) – Mother of girl scout. This part will equate to around 1-2 hours of work.

**Voiceover Roles**

Matt – 20 – 30 years old (any race) – Connor’s coworker that calls him over the phone regarding a work issue.

Rebecca – 30 -40 years old (any race) – Connor’s manager that joins the phone call regarding work issue.

Comedian on Podcast – 30 – 50 years old (any race) – Comedian is played over a speaker riffing on Huntingtons disease.

sharedPost.text:
**Casting Call - Don't Go Yet **

Logline/Genre - Don’t Go Yet is a short film and passion project of mine. It is a dark dramedy focused on a pair of best friends Adam and Connor. When Adam walks in on a failed suicide attempt by Connor, he persuades him to give twenty-four hours to convince him life is worth living. If he fails, Connor may go through with the suicide with no interruption.

Dates and Locations – Dates have been nailed down but we are aiming for two to three weekends of shooting at the end of October/beginning of November. Locations are close to being locked in with one in Wheat Ridge and the other in Westminster.

Director – Cody Pape

Director of Photography – Alex Sistare

Compensation – The two leads will be paid $150 - $200 a day. Rest of the cast will be unpaid. Snacks and meals will be provided on all shoot days. You’ll also receive credit for the film.

Union Status – Non-union

Audition information - If interested please email [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) with the subject line “Don’t Go Yet – Your Name” with head shots, reels and any other applicable material and I will send sides in response. Once we have dates locked, we plan to hold in-person auditions for the two leads and most of the supporting cast.

Project Notes –** **Please note that this project contains heavy drug use and acts of suicide and self-harm.

**Characters**

Connor – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A scrawny, handsome but unkept male that has lost all excitement about life. A small number of tattoos is preferred but not a requirement. He was once a very loving, outgoing person loved by many before everyone around him started to grow up. He refuses to make changes in his life due to the effort required to make them. Contact with close friends has depleted and he hasn’t been on a date in years. The only consistent thing in his life that brings him genuine joy is his best friend, Adam. He’s not miserable but he’s not happy. He’s done with the monotony of existing.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging, plastic bag over the head and prat falls are included in this role.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Adam – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) - Adam is an average height; muscular man covered in tattoos with a smile they would use in a toothpaste advertisement. It's not mentioned that he is ex-military, but his appearance would suggest he served. He has a handful of extremely close relationships with men in his life but dates a new woman every month. He is the epitome of toxic masculinity and has no idea how to express himself. All feelings and emotions are under lock and key except when it comes to Connor who has access at times.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Alec – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – College buddy of Connor’s. Smaller in size. Timid and has trouble sticking up for himself. Is always in the circle but has trouble getting a word in.

Amanda – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – A mutual friend of Adam and Connor’s. What once was an extremely important platonic friendship for Connor who could come to Amanda with any problem and get the support needed has become something distant to the point that Amanda has given up on the friendship. She is energetic, bubbly and can be a little bit of a steamroller in conversation. She finds it easy to give relationship advice but can’t figure out why she hasn’t found Mr. Right yet.

Gabe – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male or female (any race) – Connor and Adam’s old guitar player in a band that was taking off before Connor decided to self-sabotage the success. Gabe doesn’t hold any resentment. He lives in the moment at all times and couldn’t bother himself with what happened yesterday or the events of tomorrow.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Greg – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A high school friend of Connor and Adam’s. The starting quarterback that had all eyes on him on and off the field has had trouble accepting that time of his life is no longer around. He doesn’t have a lot going on upstairs. He assumed his body would take him places until laziness and beer took that from him. He is large and in charge in conversation and physical appearance. He picks on those smaller than him, projecting his own pain but is also quite oblivious to anyone’s feelings but his own.

Hailey – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – Connor’s ex-girlfriend. To Connor, Hailey is the one that got away. They’re not together for many reasons but when they look at each other, there is an unspoken agreement that they will try again at some point. Hailey is the struggling artist that has it all figured out on the outside but due to past trauma can’t seem to give herself over to anyone once it becomes serious. Indie, alternative, mildly goth aesthetic. Piercings and tattoos are encouraged.

Tim – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Amanda’s new boyfriend that give’s Connor some perspective on life. Tim is a counterweight to Amanda’s energy and appears to be the answer to her prayers. You can tell they’re madly in love by the synchronicity of their laughter.

Vinny – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Singer or Guitar player of Adam and Connor’s old band. He was also Connor’s closest friend aside from Adam. He’s gone on with the band’s name with new members and is seeing the success that Connor always dreamed of. Both Connor and Vinny hold resentment towards each other. Vinny see’s Connor as wasted potential while Connor sees him as a sellout.

Preferred skills
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Look forward to hearing from you!

Casting two 13-15 year old male/female actors for short film. 

Title: "The Commie"

A short comedy about a middling actor who forces his family to commit to his method style of performance after being cast as the lead in a community theater production of “Oliver Twist.”

Ability to play annoyed siblings who find solace in one another as they begrudgingly participate in their father’s method actor style of character preparation.

Company: MccDrew, LLC

Shoot Dates: Sat Nov. 21st – Sun. Nov. 22nd. 

Pay: $150/day

Send headshot and a 1-2 min. comedic monologue to: [wctreat@gmail.com](mailto:wctreat@gmail.com)

Calling all filmmakers! The 2027 edition has just launched - and we want to see YOUR short films!

Now in their 5th year, the free-to-enter Awards are bigger than ever. This year, we introduced a brand new Immersive category, presented by Meta, celebrating how immersive formats expand the way we experience storytelling.

The filmmakers behind 34 shortlisted films will be flown to Los Angeles to attend a four-day industry program on the Sony Pictures Studios lot to help elevate their careers. You will learn from Sony Pictures executives through workshops, masterclasses, panel discussions, screenings, demos, tours and Q&As.

The week ends with a bang at a red carpet Awards ceremony, a perfect opportunity to network with fellow filmmakers and industry experts.

The six categories are:
• Fiction
• Non-Fiction
• Animation
🆕 Immersive
• Student
• Future Format

Why enter? 

✈️ Be flown to Los Angeles for an exclusive industry program (flights + accommodation included)
✍️ Gain unparalleled access to the inner workings of the industry through sessions and masterclasses led by Sony Pictures executives
🎩 Celebrate your success and network with fellow creatives at the Awards night on the Sony Pictures Studios lot
🎥 Winners receive a range of prizes depending on their category, including Sony camera equipment, a Meta VR device, and cash prizes. 

🆕Also new this year: The Snapdragon Shorts Award. Five filmmakers, selected from the 2027 shortlist, will be given an array of Snapdragon powered devices and equipment including a smartphone and laptop to create an original short film. The winner receives an all-expenses-paid trip to Hawaii for an official announcement and film premiere at the Snapdragon Summit and exposure to millions through the Snapdragon Insiders community.

Take the next exciting step in your filmmaking career, widen your professional network and gain insight from people who have shaped the industry today.

🔗 Enter your short film for free now! Link in bio.

@sonypictures @metaquest

Søges: Kvinder i alle aldre i hele landet til at mime med kort musikvideo/ reel 🎬✨
I forbindelse med udgivelsen af mit debutalbum A Woman’s Heart i november, søger jeg kvinder i alle aldre i hele landet til et et kort klip til en reel!

Hvad går det ud på?

Du skal blot filme en kort selfie-video (tæt på ansigtet), hvor du mimer med på omkvædet (musikken bliver lagt på bagefter) – enten med et stort smil, et fjollet udtryk eller bare ren god energi. Sangen handler nemlig om at slippe sig fri som kvinde, og omkvædet er supernemt at lære! 

Tanken er mange korte klip fra mange forskellige kvinder, så man ser dig højst sandsynligt kun i et par sekunder. ☺️

Det praktiske:

• Du filmer det selv derhjemme - burde ikke tage mere end 15 min. 

• Honorar: Der er et lille symbolsk honorar for din tid, da det også er en lille opgave og min økonomi ikke er så stor endnu. 

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, så send mig en besked - så sender jeg sangen og mere info! ☺️

Vi samler 5 deltagere, som hver især har én vild, sjov eller usædvanlig historie fra deres liv.

STAFFING BOSTON CELTICS & BRUINS!!
Branded Promo Talent, a leading experiential marketing agency, is seeking reliable, enthusiastic, and professional Brand Ambassadors to represent TD Bank at Boston Celtics and Boston Bruins home games at TD Garden in Boston, MA!

Event 1: Celtics

Friday, October 23, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Event 2: Bruins

Saturday, October 24, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Location:

TD Garden

100 Legends Way

Boston, MA 02114

Compensation:

Team Lead — $35 per hour

Brand Ambassadors — $30 per hour

— 1099, paid weekly —

Parking:

Parking reimbursed with receipt.

Attire:

Branded t-shirts will be provided. Wear black pants (no leggings, sweatpants, or ripped/torn jeans) with clean, comfortable white sneakers. Long-sleeved black or white layers may be worn underneath the branded shirt, and black jackets are permitted as needed for colder weather.

Event Details: 

TD Bank is bringing game-day excitement to TD Garden for back-to-back home games featuring the Boston Celtics on Friday and the Boston Bruins on Saturday! Brand Ambassadors will be stationed throughout the exterior plaza and indoor concourse areas, engaging with fans, creating personalized player trading cards, and assisting with interactive games.

Team Lead Duties: 

• Must have experience leading large teams. 

• Oversee staff and coordinate team assignments. 

• Ensure smooth event execution and client communication. 

• Capture event photos and submit recaps.

Staff Duties:

• Assist with event prep, execution, and breakdown to ensure smooth operations.

• Engage with fans, communicate key brand messaging, and guide guests through the activation. 

• Maintain a fun, welcoming, and energetic atmosphere to create memorable fan experiences. 

• Support event activities, manage guest flow, and assist with giveaways.

Staff Expectations: 

We want high-energy, outgoing, and engaging Brand Ambassadors who know how to hype a crowd and create great vibes. You must be punctual, professional, and ready to bring it from start to finish!

Application Process:

To be considered, email chrissy@brandedpromotalent.com with the following:

• Availability

• Resume

• Headshot

• Relevant experience

• A brief description of why you're an excellent fit for this role.

Please use "TD Garden - Celtics & Bruins" as the subject of your email.

Note: Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered. Our team will review qualifications via email and schedule a call with eligible candidates.
