# 🎬 CASTING CALL — LAINEY | THE BROS SHOW

**Unpaid Acting Opportunity | South or West London**
## ABOUT THE PROJECT

We're looking for an actress to play **Lainey**, a key character in *The Bros Show* — an independent South London teen sitcom blending chaotic comedy, mockumentary-style filming, friendship, romance and everyday life.

*The Bros Show* follows a group of friends whose ambitions, arguments and ridiculous ideas constantly get them into trouble. The series has a natural, handheld mockumentary style, with improvised-feeling banter, awkward camera moments and plenty of personality.

We're looking for someone who can bring Lainey to life and become part of the show's creative journey.
## 🎭 THE ROLE — LAINEY

**Character age:** 17
**Role type:** Recurring character
**Location requirement:** Applicants must be based in South or West London.

Lainey is confident, witty, flirty, stubborn and fiercely independent. She has a playful side, a sharp tongue and a habit of getting under Aweys's skin just to see how he reacts.

She and Aweys have known each other since childhood. After spending time apart while Lainey worked on herself and built her own life, she returns to New Harbour and reconnects with him and the rest of the group.

Their relationship is full of teasing, competitive banter, playful arguments and genuine affection. She can make Aweys speechless one minute and roast him the next.

But Lainey isn't just a love interest. She has her own ambitions, including music, fashion, styling and art. She's independent, loyal, occasionally difficult to read, and determined to be recognised for who she really is.

**We're looking for an actress who can portray:**
* Confident, natural and expressive acting.
* Quick-witted comedy and believable banter.
* Playful flirting and strong on-screen chemistry.
* A character who can be sweet, stubborn, intimidating and affectionate.
* Genuine emotion when the comedy gives way to more personal moments.

You don't need to be an established professional actor. We're interested in personality, commitment, creativity and the ability to make the character feel real.
## 💇‍♀️ APPEARANCE & STYLE

The character has a specific visual concept:
* White female character with blonde hair.
* Long, layered hair falling past the shoulders.
* Soft waves and a natural, slightly messy finish.
* A relaxed 1990s/Y2K-inspired aesthetic.
* Signature outfit inspiration: an *NSYNC T-shirt and a backwards cap.
* Casual, feminine streetwear that suits her confident personality.

The visual inspiration is Jill from *Party of Five*, with a **“cute but dangerous”** vibe.

Please include recent photographs showing your current appearance when applying. Blonde hair is the intended character look; please state whether your hair is naturally blonde, dyed blonde or would require styling.
## 📍 LOCATION REQUIREMENT

**This casting call is for actors based in South London or West London only.**

Applicants must be able to travel to the filming and rehearsal locations. Please consider your travel arrangements and availability before applying.

Exact meeting points, filming dates and schedules will be communicated to shortlisted applicants.
## 🎥 AUDITION PROCESS

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to perform an audition tape based on a scene titled **“Six Wings and a Reunion.”**

The scene takes place at a chicken shop and a football pitch. It tests the chemistry between Lainey and Aweys through natural conversation, teasing, competitive football banter and a more affectionate moment.

We're looking for a performance that feels natural rather than overly rehearsed. The character should come across as confident and playful without losing her emotional depth.

Further audition instructions and the script will be provided to selected applicants.

Callbacks or a chemistry test may follow, depending on the audition results.
## 📅 AVAILABILITY & COMMITMENT

Please state your general availability for rehearsals and filming when applying.

The role is intended to be recurring, so we are looking for someone who can commit to the agreed filming schedule and communicate reliably.

Filming dates, expected time commitments and the arrangements for future appearances will be discussed before casting is finalised.
## 💷 PAYMENT & EXPENSES

**This is an unpaid independent production.**

There is currently no guaranteed payment or reimbursement for travel, food or other expenses. Applicants should only apply if they are comfortable with these terms.

Any future changes to payment or expenses will be communicated clearly rather than assumed.
## 📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send the following:
1. Your name or preferred professional name.
2. Your age.
3. Your general location — South or West London.
4. Recent photographs showing your current appearance.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous work, if available.
6. Your general availability for filming and rehearsals.
7. A short introduction explaining why you would like to play Lainey.

You do not need professional acting credits to apply.

**Please do not send sensitive personal information or your full home address.** If you are under 18, a parent or guardian should be involved in the casting and filming arrangements.
## 🌟 A FINAL NOTE

Lainey is an important character in *The Bros Show*, and we're looking for someone who can bring her personality, humour and individuality to the screen.

If you love comedy, enjoy performing and think you could bring this character to life, we'd love to hear from you.

**Project:** The Bros Show
**Role:** Lainey
**Character age:** 17
**Casting area:** South or West London
**Payment:** Unpaid
**Application:** Send the requested details and photographs by private message.

🎬 **Let's find our Lainey.**

*The Bros Show* follows a group of friends whose ambitions, arguments and ridiculous ideas constantly get them into trouble. The series has a natural, handheld mockumentary style, with improvised-feeling banter, awkward camera moments and plenty of personality.

We're looking for someone who can bring Lainey to life and become part of the show's creative journey.
## 🎭 THE ROLE — LAINEY

**Character age:** 17
**Role type:** Recurring character
**Location requirement:** Applicants must be based in South or West London.

Lainey is confident, witty, flirty, stubborn and fiercely independent. She has a playful side, a sharp tongue and a habit of getting under Aweys's skin just to see how he reacts.

She and Aweys have known each other since childhood. After spending time apart while Lainey worked on herself and built her own life, she returns to New Harbour and reconnects with him and the rest of the group.

Their relationship is full of teasing, competitive banter, playful arguments and genuine affection. She can make Aweys speechless one minute and roast him the next.

But Lainey isn't just a love interest. She has her own ambitions, including music, fashion, styling and art. She's independent, loyal, occasionally difficult to read, and determined to be recognised for who she really is.

**We're looking for an actress who can portray:**
* Confident, natural and expressive acting.
* Quick-witted comedy and believable banter.
* Playful flirting and strong on-screen chemistry.
* A character who can be sweet, stubborn, intimidating and affectionate.
* Genuine emotion when the comedy gives way to more personal moments.

You don't need to be an established professional actor. We're interested in personality, commitment, creativity and the ability to make the character feel real.
## 💇‍♀️ APPEARANCE & STYLE

The character has a specific visual concept:
* White female character with blonde hair.
* Long, layered hair falling past the shoulders.
* Soft waves and a natural, slightly messy finish.
* A relaxed 1990s/Y2K-inspired aesthetic.
* Signature outfit inspiration: an *NSYNC T-shirt and a backwards cap.
* Casual, feminine streetwear that suits her confident personality.

The visual inspiration is Jill from *Party of Five*, with a **“cute but dangerous”** vibe.

Please include recent photographs showing your current appearance when applying. Blonde hair is the intended character look; please state whether your hair is naturally blonde, dyed blonde or would require styling.
## 📍 LOCATION REQUIREMENT

**This casting call is for actors based in South London or West London only.**

Applicants must be able to travel to the filming and rehearsal locations. Please consider your travel arrangements and availability before applying.

Exact meeting points, filming dates and schedules will be communicated to shortlisted applicants.
## 🎥 AUDITION PROCESS

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to perform an audition tape based on a scene titled **“Six Wings and a Reunion.”**

The scene takes place at a chicken shop and a football pitch. It tests the chemistry between Lainey and Aweys through natural conversation, teasing, competitive football banter and a more affectionate moment.

We're looking for a performance that feels natural rather than overly rehearsed. The character should come across as confident and playful without losing her emotional depth.

Further audition instructions and the script will be provided to selected applicants.

Callbacks or a chemistry test may follow, depending on the audition results.
## 📅 AVAILABILITY & COMMITMENT

Please state your general availability for rehearsals and filming when applying.

The role is intended to be recurring, so we are looking for someone who can commit to the agreed filming schedule and communicate reliably.

Filming dates, expected time commitments and the arrangements for future appearances will be discussed before casting is finalised.
## 💷 PAYMENT & EXPENSES

**This is an unpaid independent production.**

There is currently no guaranteed payment or reimbursement for travel, food or other expenses. Applicants should only apply if they are comfortable with these terms.

Any future changes to payment or expenses will be communicated clearly rather than assumed.
## 📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send the following:
1. Your name or preferred professional name.
2. Your age.
3. Your general location — South or West London.
4. Recent photographs showing your current appearance.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous work, if available.
6. Your general availability for filming and rehearsals.
7. A short introduction explaining why you would like to play Lainey.

You do not need professional acting credits to apply.

**Please do not send sensitive personal information or your full home address.** If you are under 18, a parent or guardian should be involved in the casting and filming arrangements.
## 🌟 A FINAL NOTE

Lainey is an important character in *The Bros Show*, and we're looking for someone who can bring her personality, humour and individuality to the screen.

If you love comedy, enjoy performing and think you could bring this character to life, we'd love to hear from you.

**Project:** The Bros Show
**Role:** Lainey
**Character age:** 17
**Casting area:** South or West London
**Payment:** Unpaid
**Application:** Send the requested details and photographs by private message.

🎬 **Let's find our Lainey.**

# **CASTING CALL: VERSATILE MALE  IDENTIFYING PERFORMERS FOR PANTOMIME TOUR**

**Umbrella Theatre Productions** is currently seeking dynamic, highly skilled male-identifying performers to join our upcoming TIE (Theatre in Education) Pantomime Tour across London and the Home Counties this November and December.

We are casting for two concurrent touring productions: ***Jack and the Beanstalk*** and ***Aladdin***.

This is a fantastic opportunity for energetic performers who thrive in a fast-paced, interactive environment and possess a strong passion for delivering high-quality theatrical experiences to young audiences.

**ROLE REQUIREMENTS & CASTING CRITERIA**
* **Versatility & Vocal Ability:** Must be a highly versatile character actor with excellent comedic timing, strong physical theatre skills, and confident singing ability.
* **Facilitation Skills:** Exceptional ability to command a room. You must be highly confident in delivering workshop-style interactive teaching and crowd management for large groups of up to 150 primary school students.
* **Logistics:** A Full UK Driving Licence is essential. Access to your own vehicle is a strong advantage.
* **Team Player:** Must be adaptable, reliable, and comfortable with the rigorous nature of a get-in/get-out touring schedule.

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
* **Rehearsal & Tour Dates:** November and December 2026. Excellent availability is specifically required for the early to mid-December peak period.
* **Locations:** London and the Home Counties.
* **Remuneration:** £1,350 – £2,000 (Dependent on experience and total length of engagement).

**SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS** We are currently accepting first-round submissions via video self-tape.

To be considered, please submit your Spotlight link/CV, a brief cover note outlining your driving/vehicle status,by **Friday, 23rd October 2026**.

*hello@umbrellatheatreproductions.com *

**Umbrella Theatre Productions is committed to diversity and encourages submissions from performers of all backgrounds.**

Thanks!

This is a fantastic opportunity for energetic performers who thrive in a fast-paced, interactive environment and possess a strong passion for delivering high-quality theatrical experiences to young audiences.

**ROLE REQUIREMENTS & CASTING CRITERIA**
* **Versatility & Vocal Ability:** Must be a highly versatile character actor with excellent comedic timing, strong physical theatre skills, and confident singing ability.
* **Facilitation Skills:** Exceptional ability to command a room. You must be highly confident in delivering workshop-style interactive teaching and crowd management for large groups of up to 150 primary school students.
* **Logistics:** A Full UK Driving Licence is essential. Access to your own vehicle is a strong advantage.
* **Team Player:** Must be adaptable, reliable, and comfortable with the rigorous nature of a get-in/get-out touring schedule.

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
* **Rehearsal & Tour Dates:** November and December 2026. Excellent availability is specifically required for the early to mid-December peak period.
* **Locations:** London and the Home Counties.
* **Remuneration:** £1,350 – £2,000 (Dependent on experience and total length of engagement).

**SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS** We are currently accepting first-round submissions via video self-tape.

To be considered, please submit your Spotlight link/CV, a brief cover note outlining your driving/vehicle status,by **Friday, 23rd October 2026**.

*hello@umbrellatheatreproductions.com *

**Umbrella Theatre Productions is committed to diversity and encourages submissions from performers of all backgrounds.**

Thanks!

**CASTING CALL: AUDITIONS OPEN** 

**Project Title:** ***The Life That I Want ***

**Shoot Dates:** Early December

**Rehearsals:** 2–3 days in late November

**Produced by: **Dimas Films 

**Location:** Denver, CO 

**Non-Union / Unpaid (Copy, Credit, and Meals Provided)**
**ABOUT THE PROJECT**

Leaving his home country to chase his Hollywood dream, Javier is paralyzed by a stage fright that keeps him trapped behind self-imposed walls. When an unexpected opportunity forces him into the spotlight, his journey intersects with Hayley, Kerlen, and Rumie—others facing their own internal barriers. Bound by a shared passion and a powerful musical centerpiece, they unite through movement and song to shatter their fears and embrace the true heart of their craft.

*Note: This is a dance- and movement-focused short film. All musical numbers will be ****lip-synced****—no live vocal performance or singing required!*
**CHARACTER BREAKDOWNS**
**1. HAYLEY**
* **Gender/Age:** Female, 18–25 (Any Ethnicity)
* **Description:** Expressive, intensely passionate, yet guarded. Hayley carries her own deep-seated internal barriers that hold her back from unleashing her full potential. She needs strong emotional depth and dynamic dance ability to convey her character's internal journey through movement.
**2. KERLEN**
* **Gender/Age:** Any Gender, 40+ (Any Ethnicity)
* **Description:** Resilient, determined, and deeply passionate, Kerlen acts as a crucial pillar in the ensemble—yet she is privately consumed by self-doubt. Struggling with the fear that time is running out, she constantly worries that she is too old to pursue her artistic dreams or that she will be judged by her peers and industry standards. Through her connection with Javier and the group, Kerlen learns to break free from these self-imposed limitations, proving that passion and artistry have no age limit. Strong stage presence and expressive physical storytelling are essential.
**3. RUMIE**
* **Gender/Age: **male, 18–25 (Any Ethnicity)
* **Description:** Vibrant, perceptive, and highly empathetic, yet fighting a quiet battle against anxiety. Rumie’s energy helps spark connection within the group. Looking for an actor/dancer with high emotional range and fluid movement skills.
**FEATURED DANCERS & ENSEMBLE**
* **Ages:** 18 to 45+ (All Genders, All Ethnicities)
* **Description:** We are seeking versatile dancers, Extras, and performers of all backgrounds and body types who want to participate in sharing this beautiful story. Performers should be comfortable with contemporary, jazz, or storytelling-focused choreography and able to express strong emotion through movement.
**SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS**

To be considered, please submit to **dimasfilmsinfo@gmail.com **the following:
1. **Headshot & Resume** (or current photos and relevant performance/dance background).
2. **Video Submission:** A **30s dance choreography video** demonstrating your movement style, rhythm, and emotional expression. (Can be self-choreographed or a showcase of past work). **( Optional )**
3. **Availability:** Confirmation that you are available for late November rehearsals and early December filming days in the Denver area.

Hello all! Happy spooky season. We at Birnamwood Productions are filming a fun, short music video on the weekend of November 7 + 8, looking for cast and crew who want to use their Halloween costumes just a little bit longer. Using the song F.a.S.T by local artist Seattle Kaye, we’re aiming for a Thriller-esque short of an oblivious pizza guy who delivers to a haunted house, puts on his headphones, and then dances unwittingly through a bunch of monsters trying to eat him. 

The location is in the Calhan area, and it will be an overnight shoot.

**Title:** Special Delivery

**Logline:** An oblivious pizza driver delivers a pizza in an obviously haunted house.

**Length:** 2-3 minutes, should be done in a single shoot day.

We’re looking for actors and costumes that lean toward biohazard, zombie, or alien aesthetics. We will have a stunt coordinator on site, so if you haven’t ever worked stunts before, this is a great time to learn. 

We are also casting one person for Oblivious Pizza Guy to dance through the haunted house ― if auditioning for that role, please include a clip of yourself dancing to F.a.S.T by Seattle Kaye.

We are also on the hunt for an ART DIRECTOR, so if you’re available, have experience with horror, and want to go all out for a silly horror comedy, be sure to let us know!

Casting Call link: 

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfF8C584mNbWj05bAOH4H0H3y6Yiv7FXlyGkVRceQvUOHW6Sg/viewform?usp=publish-editor](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfF8C584mNbWj05bAOH4H0H3y6Yiv7FXlyGkVRceQvUOHW6Sg/viewform?usp=publish-editor)

Hope to hear from you soon!

Cześć wszystkim! 

**Szukam możliwości zdobycia doświadczenia i nawiązania kontaktów w branży filmowej, szczególnie w obszarze kostiumografii i stylizacji!**

Niedawno wróciłam do Polski po ukończeniu studiów Fashion Design w Wielkiej Brytanii i chciałabym rozwijać swoje umiejętności również przy produkcjach filmowych, reklamowych i teledyskach.

Mam doświadczenie w projektowaniu odzieży, szyciu, konstrukcji ubioru oraz pracy nad kreatywnymi projektami. Chętnie zaangażuję się w pracę na planie, pomoc w dziale kostiumów, przygotowywanie stylizacji czy asystowanie kostiumografom i stylistom. Jestem też otwarta na inne możliwości, które pozwolą mi poznać branżę filmową od kulis.

Aktualnie mieszkam w Gdańsku, ale jestem otwarta na współpracę również w innych miastach, szczególnie w Warszawie.

Jeśli ktoś wie o stażach, praktykach, nadchodzących produkcjach lub zna osoby, z którymi warto się skontaktować, będę ogromnie wdzięczna za wszelkie wskazówki! 🫶 Mile widziane są również porady dotyczące tego, jak zacząć pracę w tej branży.

Poniżej wrzucam kilka swoich projektów, a więcej moich prac można zobaczyć na Instagramie @by.zvza. Chętnie prześlę również pełne portfolio i CV.

Dziękuję za każdą pomoc!

🎪 **Szukam osób z cyrkowymi, akrobatycznymi i „dziwnymi” talentami - nagrania TFP, Warszawa, sobota 24.10**

Cześć! Przygotowuję niekomercyjny projekt wideo. To nie jest reklama żadnego produktu, tylko materiał robiony dla doświadczenia i do portfolio, w formule TFP.

**Kogo szukam:**
Aktorów, statystów i wszystkich, którzy potrafią coś nietypowego, na przykład akrobatykę, żonglerkę, gibkość, chodzenie na rękach albo talent, o którym nikt by nie pomyślał. Im bardziej zaskakujący, tym lepiej 😉

🔥 **Szczególnie szukam też artysty fireshow**, czyli osoby, która kręci ogniem (poi, kij, wachlarze itp.), tak jak na pokazach cyrkowych.

📍 **Gdzie:** Warszawa, ul. Mińska
📅 **Kiedy:** sobota, 24 października
⏱️ **Ile:** ok. 3-4 godziny
👥 **Poszukuję:** 3-5 osób

**Co oferuję:**
✅ zwrot kosztów dojazdu
✅ wyżywienie na planie
✅ materiał do portfolio
✅ udział w nietypowym projekcie

Jeśli Cię to zainteresowało, napisz do mnie prywatnie albo zostaw komentarz. Jeśli masz zdjęcie albo nagranie swojego talentu, też chętnie je zobaczę. Resztę szczegółów chętnie opowiem w wiadomości 🙌
